text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.4.01 to eu-west1 group complete. Triggering post-deploy smoke and synthetic rerank checks now.
synth-bot: SYNTH ALERT: rerank_route p95 429 spike detected on eu-canary-5 (60s window) — 37 429s, baseline 0-1. First failure 12:03:15 UTC. Sample response headers: "x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 1012"
erin: interesting, long upstream time + 429s. could be backend rejecting due to concurrency limit. can we tail the proxy logs on eu-canary-5?
frank: tails: `kubectl -n proxy logs proxy-eu-canary-5 -c envoy --since=5m | grep rerank` shows many `HTTP/1.1 429` entries and repeated `rate_limited` messages in filter logs. snippet:
```
[2026-04-01T12:03:10Z] filter: rate_limited: key=service:reranker:conns, limit=200, current=205
[2026-04-01T12:03:11Z] proxy: upstream request timeout 1001ms
```
gina: we pushed a new envoy rate-limit config in this release (PR #4321) that consolidated per-route limits; looks like the reranker default got a lower shared quota.
ops-bot: Current canary health: cpu 42%, mem 61%, proxy conn 210/220, socket listen queue 128/128 on eu-canary-5.
jules: that listen queue full is worrying. two mitigation paths: A) throttle client concurrency at router (quick config revert/pin) B) pause rollout and revert envoy config. which is faster?
erin: pinning routes to previous routing policy (pre-envoy change) should be instant and transparent. we can also set a temporary rate-limit override for rerank to higher cap while we cut a proper fix.
frank: I can apply a targeted routing pin for rerank only: `deployctl routing set --scope canary --route /v1/rerank --variant rwd-rerank-v2@sha256:prev987` then trigger synth recheck.
gina: I prefer full revert of the envoy filter in canary as safer long-term, but agrees pin + override is lower blast. i'll prep hotfix PR to fix rate-limit merge logic and add a test harness for per-route caps. ETA 90m for PR + CI.
jules: timeline: apply pin now, run synth probe, if green in 5m, allow staged rollout to continue; keep pause window open 2h for hotfix merge. ops keep eye on listen queue.
deploy-bot: Applying route pin: canary -> rwd-rerank-v2@sha256:prev987 for /v1/rerank. Change applied.
synth-bot: POST-PIN SYNTH: rerank_route p95 now 210ms, 429s 0 in last 60s. eu-canary-5 probe OK.
ops-bot: eu-canary-5 listen queue dropped to 8/128 after pin. connections stabilizing.
erin: good. please also run a lightweight soak for 15m on canary rerank traffic before resuming full rollout.
frank: initiating soak: `k6 run --vus 60 --duration 15m scripts/rerank_soak.js --env target=eu-canary-5`
gina: created ENG-3490 with root cause and remediation steps. will include release note blurb: "envoy rate-limit config incorrectly consolidated per-route quotas; temporary pin applied; hotfix pending."
jules: adding this to the release window notes and notifying support. keep thread open until hotfix merged or rollback decided.
deploy-bot: Rollout note appended: temporary pin for rerank in canary, synth pass succeeded, soak started.
